purpose: Prepare an iPhone-only, zero-wager manual evidence path to identify the exact served provider/wrapper and visible persistent-state semantics before any HAR or wager is considered.

captureOrder.instruction: Open Ocean Magic without spinning and capture the full initial screen plus any splash/loading/provider logo visible before the game becomes interactive.
Open Help/Info/Rules and capture provider/copyright/version/RTP text and every section describing bubbles, wilds, bet levels, persistence, saved positions, resets or state behavior.
Before any spin, capture the complete reels and all visible bubble/wild/meter state at the currently selected bet level.
Only if the UI allows changing bet level without a spin, switch between bet levels and capture whether bubble positions/state change. Do not press Spin.

acceptance.providerVerifiedOnlyIf: Current served game UI/help explicitly names IGT or exposes an exact provider/version fingerprint independently reviewable.
acceptance.persistentMechanismVerifiedOnlyIf: Current served rules explicitly describe persistence/saved bubble positions or equivalent exact state semantics for this build.
